morphology.formula: ∅ + Alaric → Alaric（外来专名，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 本词是外来人名，不按马来语词缀拆分。正文规范写作 Alaric；所列 IPA 是英语读法，不代表经核实的标准马来语读音。输入包没有音节划分或爪夷文，故保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 阿拉里克：源于日耳曼语传统的男性人名，也见于历史人物姓名，如西哥特统治者阿拉里克一世。
senses.en_definition: Alaric: a masculine personal name of Germanic origin, borne by historical figures including a Visigothic ruler.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang berasal daripada tradisi bahasa Germanik, antaranya nama seorang pemerintah Visigoth.
senses.nuances: 词性为专有名词。输入包未提供 DBP 释义，不能将其认定为已核实的官方马来语普通词，因此 status 标为 unverified。马来语释义为编辑性说明。下列是历史姓名组合，并非普通词的高频搭配。人名来源和英语读音参见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/alaric)。

etymology.historical_story: Alaric belongs to the Germanic naming tradition and is conventionally interpreted as 'ruler of all'. Its historical elements are associated with 'all' and 'ruler'; they are not Malay morphemes. The name is remembered through Visigothic history and later personal naming. In Malay writing, it functions as a borrowed proper name. See [the name's etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Alaric).
